rename-closepaw.title: Rename: Android Agent → ClosePaw
rename-closepaw.description: Rename product from com.moonkey.androidagent to ai.closepaw. New applicationId, display name ClosePaw, theme Theme.ClosePaw, Kotlin package ai.closepaw. Pre-release, no backcompat. Phased one-commit-per-phase on a single branch; each phase ends build-green. Historical docs (doc/archive, doc/autotune, doc/todo/**/final|initial, eval/results) are frozen. See design for rationale.
acceptCriteria: aapt dump badging app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk | grep -q "package: name='ai.closepaw'"

rc-0-audit.title: Audit rename scope
rc-0-audit.description: Produce doc/todo/rename-closepaw/audit.md: (1) per-phase file lists enumerating every file the sed rules will touch, (2) a separate section of ambiguous prose sites where 'Android agent' may refer to the platform-level concept and needs manual review in phase 5, (3) an explicit exclusion list confirming doc/archive, doc/autotune, doc/todo/**/final|initial, eval/results, build/, .cxx/, .worktrees/ are skipped. Use git ls-files + grep; do NOT modify any code or docs in this task.

rc-1-gradle.title: Phase 1: Gradle identity (namespace + applicationId + rootProject)
rc-1-gradle.description: Change settings.gradle.kts rootProject.name to "ClosePaw". Change app/build.gradle.kts namespace and applicationId to "ai.closepaw". Do NOT touch Kotlin sources or resources yet — this phase only proves the Gradle config parses. Build will not assemble yet (Kotlin package still com.moonkey.androidagent); that's expected and fixed in phase 2.
acceptCriteria: git diff --stat main -- settings.gradle.kts app/build.gradle.kts | grep -q '2 files changed'
rc-1-gradle.note: 3 files changed (design spec said 2, audit surfaced app/proguard-rules.pro as a 3rd Phase-1 file — keep rules referenced com.moonkey.androidagent; leaving them stale would silently break R8 shrinking). Commit 9d467940.

rc-2-kotlin.title: Phase 2: Kotlin package tree rename
rc-2-kotlin.description: For each source set (main, test, debug, release): git mv app/src/<set>/kotlin/com/moonkey/androidagent app/src/<set>/kotlin/ai/closepaw, then rmdir the empty com/moonkey tree. Rewrite all 'package com.moonkey.androidagent' → 'package ai.closepaw' and all 'import com.moonkey.androidagent' → 'import ai.closepaw' in .kt files. Rewrite intent action literal strings 'com.moonkey.androidagent.ACTION_*' → 'ai.closepaw.ACTION_*' in .kt and AndroidManifest.xml (action string constants only — NOT the manifest android:theme attribute). Use git mv so blame survives. Keep changes mechanical; do not refactor code shape.

rc-qa-real-device.title: QA Round: Real Device Validation (rename)
rc-qa-real-device.description:
Run automated end-to-end QA on a real device via adb/accessibility to validate the rename did not regress user-facing behavior. Use /ux-visual-debug for ADB-driven interaction and screenshot evidence. rc-6-verify already proves the APK identity and one smoke turn; this task is the deeper product-level QA pass.

Test scenarios:
(1) Clean install identity: uninstall com.moonkey.androidagent if present, then install ai.closepaw; launcher shows 'ClosePaw' with correct icon; app opens without crash. Capture `adb shell dumpsys package ai.closepaw` excerpt and launcher screenshot.
(2) Accessibility service enrollment: navigate Settings → Accessibility → find 'ClosePaw' (not 'Android Agent'); toggle on; service binds (logcat shows AccessibilityService connected). Capture screenshot of Accessibility settings showing ClosePaw entry.
(3) Overlay permission: grant SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW under the new applicationId; SmartCapsule overlay appears. Screenshot evidence.
(4) Basic single-turn task: 'Open Settings' completes with GOAL_ACHIEVED in session record; logcat/session show package ai.closepaw consistently.
(5) Multi-turn task: run a standard 3+ step task (e.g., one from eval/config/default.yaml) end-to-end; GOAL_ACHIEVED; no stale refs to old package in logs.
(6) Intent action: scripts/action-test.sh fires ai.closepaw.ACTION_DEBUG_EXEC and the receiver executes (action completes, logcat confirms). This proves the intent action string rename in phase 2.
(7) Session persistence: force-stop mid-task, relaunch; session checkpoint under /data/data/ai.closepaw/ loads; no crash. Confirm no leftover checkpoint at old path /data/data/com.moonkey.androidagent/ (should not exist after clean install).
(8) Eval smoke via eval runner: one eval task passes end-to-end using updated eval/config/default.yaml (package_name: ai.closepaw).
(9) Stability sweep: no crash/ANR in logcat across the full QA run.

For each scenario: capture logcat, screenshots, and session JSON as evidence under doc/todo/rename-closepaw/qa_evidence/. Write pass/fail report at doc/todo/rename-closepaw/qa_report.md.

adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief ai.closepaw | grep -q 'ai\.closepaw/\.app\.MainActivity'
adb shell settings get secure enabled_accessibility_services | grep -q 'ai\.closepaw/'

rc-4b-completion-monitor.title: Phase 4b: Fix completion_monitor.py ANR/service regex
rc-4b-completion-monitor.description: rc-qa S8 uncovered a rename miss from phase-4: eval/aw_bridge/completion_monitor.py lines 30-31 contain ANR and service-timeout regex patterns that still match the old package name com.moonkey.androidagent. With the renamed APK these patterns never fire, so the eval harness's auto-abort on agent crash is neutered. LOW severity but real rename regression. Mechanical one-file fix: replace the old-package substring with ai.closepaw in both regex literals. The .pyc bytecode regenerates on next run. No test-suite changes needed; completion_monitor is exercised by test_completion_monitor.py which already runs green.
acceptCriteria: git diff --name-only HEAD~0 | grep -v '^eval/aw_bridge/completion_monitor\.py$' | grep . && exit 1 || true
